scope: Current Dijkstra goal-distance Hybrid family and its paired five-action Direct controls. Historical prompt/task extensions are disclosed. No compact-lattice, analytic-only, API-key or selected older Direct baseline is substituted.

metric.name: Recorded control time excluding measured video overhead
excludes: startup/reset and terminal video finalization already outside control_elapsed_s
metric.note: Component timers overlap; do not sum model_pipeline, field expansion and decision timings.

shared_setup.observation_input: Task text, paired external/wrist RGB, measured robot state and observable history; one immutable external demo only for explicitly marked rows. Evaluator object poses/contact telemetry never enter policy input.

caveats: Do not present the three earlier goal-only pairs as evidence that the latest zero-shot collision-free protocol succeeds.
All rows are single episodes, with stochastic generation, subscription latency and caching; no confidence interval or general success-rate claim is supported.
The relayout adjusted gain is small and reverses the raw wall-time ordering; label the timing metric explicitly.
A passing offline audit establishes recorded protocol/accounting consistency using shared code. It is not independent physics verification or collision-free success certification.

The newest collision monitor observes discrete physics-substep contacts after they occur, and has documented allowed/excluded contacts. It is not predictive whole-arm collision avoidance or continuous swept-volume certification.
The original no-demo bowl Hybrid has an eligible goal-completion time but no matched Direct; do not pair it with an older compact/direct run.
One-demo obstacle corrected failures supersede the original LIBERO-only comparison; do not use comparison.superseded_libero_only_v1.json for slide outcomes.
Do not sum adjusted time across failure/incomplete and successful rows or pool them into an overall speedup.
